title: Open Loops state.json
description: The Orchestrator's state file in the home directory. It is the only truth between Cycles. Keys that start with 'ol-' are Worker records; the other keys are dedup maps.

chain_stalled_notified.description: Dedup map for chain-stall messages: Gated Task id -> id of the Blocked upstream Task.

alerts.description: One entry per Slot whose tools are failing. One system_alert per outage; the entry is removed on recovery.

worker.description: One record per Task that has or had a Worker and is not yet Done.

task_id.description: The Tracker's id for the Task.

spec.description: Path of the Spec file, or 'task-body' when the Task body is the Spec.

runtime_ids.description: The ids that runtime.md names for this Worker. Removed when the Worker is stopped.

last_comment_id.description: Last Review comment id that triggered a Respawn; null = none seen.

pending_prompt.description: First 60 characters of an Input Request the Owner was told about.

gap_fill_done.description: Absent = not applicable or not triggered; 'pending' = re-prompt sent; true = done.
